verdict: Leads are up sharply, but attribution gaps must be closed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 88 leads through Meta at an average cost of $5.20 per lead — a strong volume result. In the most recent 7 days, leads more than doubled compared to the prior 7-day period, driven by a significant ramp in ad spend, though cost per lead rose 30% alongside that increase, so efficiency is being watched closely as budget scales. Nine setup milestones — covering conversion tracking, landing pages, and lead nurture sequences — remain unconfirmed past their due dates, which means the leads you're receiving cannot yet be fully verified or followed up automatically. Work to complete these items is the immediate priority this week. Once attribution and nurture infrastructure are in place, you'll have a clear, end-to-end picture of every lead and what happens to it.
